in_marathi.name: Seshu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the cycles
in_marathi.long_meaning: Seshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Seshu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sesha', which means 'the endless one'. This name is given to the deity Lord Vishnu in his form as the serpent Ananta Shesha, who supports the universe on his infinite coils. Seshu is also a name for the sage Markandeya, who was granted immortality by Lord Shiva.
